description: Shut down its Octave text-to-speech and EVI (Empathic Voice Interface) APIs on 2026-11-13 (announced 2026-10-02). The voices API now returns 'This API was retired on 2026-11-13'. Hume now focuses on voice-AI evaluation (VoiceEQ) and expression measurement. Hume's TADA TTS models remain available as open weights (Llama 3.2 community licence).
name: Hume AI
